Merged from four appearances. Water is named at lines 191 and 210 as a solubility-decreasing solvent, the patent's own 'non-solvent', added to induce crystallization of form A; at line 216 as the wash liquid for the isolated solid, often in the last washing step; and at line 185 as an unsuitable solvent to be removed from a reaction mixture before crystallization. Role is solvent because the patent itself groups it with the solvents. Volumes are given only as ranges in vol. %, so quantity is null.

Feedstock for the crystallization: dissolved in one of the polar organic solvents and recovered as form A, so role is reactant here while form A is the product. No bond is formed or broken anywhere in this section. Line 220 prints the full chemical name of tembotrione, kept as an alias. The section also offers amorphous tembotrione, mixtures of crystalline modifications and mixtures of amorphous and crystalline tembotrione as feedstock at line 181; those are the same substance and are not given separate records. Concentrations of 100 to 800 g/l and purities of at least 85%, 90% or 95% are stated as ranges and minima rather than as measurements of a run, so quantity and purity_pct are null.

Crystalline form A of tembotrione: the same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice, and not a distinct chemical entity. Formula C17H16ClF3O6S. This record is form A. The product of this process. Merged from its appearances as the crystallization product at lines 163 and 218, as the seed crystals added to promote or accelerate crystallization at lines 201 to 208, and as the form the feedstock is preferably not in at line 177. The stated crystallization extent of at least 80 or 90 wt. % and the form A content of at least 90 to 96 wt. % are rule-of-thumb minima for the process, not measurements of a run, so quantity, yield_pct and purity_pct are null. Seed crystal loadings are likewise given only as wt. % ranges.
